summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, positioning Mercedes to clinch the drivers' championship with two races remaining. Rafael Camara returns to the Haas cockpit for Las Vegas following Esteban Ocon's departure, introducing uncertainty into the midfield battles. A win for Antonelli would move Mercedes closer to securing back-to-back constructors' titles while mathematically eliminating Verstappen's championship hopes.
